enchantingMessages.title: 3 NIGHTS OFFER
enchantingMessages.name: 3 notti
enchantingMessages.text: Three nights, with wine tasting and lagoon excursion
enchantingMessages.description:
Walk among the rows, discover the pristine beauty of the Marano Lagoon.
We invite you to experience 3 nights in our Farmhouse, surrounded by vineyards, among whose leaves flows a gentle and constant breeze, coming from the sea, which is only a few kilometers away.
An unforgettable experience, in the silence of the Friulian countryside, where you can taste our own wines and discover the nearby Marano Lagoon with a boat trip.

enchantingMessages.title: 2 NIGHTS OFFER
enchantingMessages.name: 2 notti
enchantingMessages.description:
Abandon the hustle and bustle of every day, immerse yourself in the quiet of the Friulian countryside.
We invite you to experience 2 nights at our Farmhouse, surrounded by vineyards, for a relaxing experience in a convivial and family atmosphere.
Two days made special by the excellence of our territory and our own wines.
